input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Preserve a cyborg shipwright with built-in weapons, compressed-air attacks, beams and cola fuel. Distinguish his own body from General Franky machinery and the Sunny. Build a playable kit with at least 15 meaningful purchasable upgrades that each change executable behavior. Select a coherent subset instead of claiming exhaustive coverage. Disclose omitted defining abilities and any source limits. Treat numerical damage, costs, cooldowns, range, targeting and unlock progression as explicit gameplay adaptations. Do not invent character powers to meet upgrade count; deepen sourced abilities where possible.

context.priorReviewCorrections: Keep descriptions within schema limits. Multi-hit Techniques cannot use area or sweep. Weak-point analysis does not establish sensing concealed enemies. Clearly disclose pre-timeskip BF36 as a historical loadout if combined with BF37.

research.subject: Franky
gaps: The supplied schema has no dedicated gameplay-loadout or upgrade-tree fields, so it cannot represent a full purchasable kit with 15 upgrades without embedding unsupported design material in claim text.

Numerical damage, costs, cooldowns, ranges, targeting rules, resource values beyond the stated cola capacity, and unlock progression are not established by the supplied pages and should be treated as explicit gameplay adaptations rather than canon facts.
The sources do not establish recoil behavior, elemental status effects, movement modifiers for attacks, area or sweep classifications, or concealed-enemy sensing.
The source supports targeting a demonstrated visible weak point, but does not establish a general weak-point-sensing ability.

The aggregated fan-wiki page includes Egghead, Elbaph, later manga material, anime material, supplementary references, and non-canon listings. Later claims such as Super Vega Cola and Egghead events were excluded from this Wano-cutoff record.

The record is a coherent combat subset rather than an exhaustive inventory. Minor gadgets, historical Battle Frankies other than BF-36, additional unnamed weapons, and many ship or construction functions are omitted.

The supplied pages do not define a complete set of distinct purchasable upgrades; any upgrade count or progression structure must therefore be designed separately and labeled as a gameplay adaptation.
No claim about who created the published character has been made; the original-concept claim category is not applicable.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.
